---
title: "Documents"
---

This section collects the documents that describe, step by step and in R, how the wood provision
ecosystem service is updated. Each document is a runnable routine, so the procedure can be inspected
and repeated from the repository. Every document can also be downloaded as a PDF.

## Methods

[Wood provision](methods/wood-provision/index.qmd)
: Builds the physical accounts. It estimates the net annual increment of forest available for wood
  supply by country for 2000 to 2024, compares it with removals to flag overuse, and maps it at 1 km
  resolution.

[Monetary valuation](methods/monetary-valuation/index.qmd)
: Gives the physical flow a value in euro, in current and constant (2010) prices, and maps it.
